verdict.rationale: Aircall is a SaaS cloud-phone platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents a public REST API, OAuth, webhooks and in-product AI Agents and Assistants, but none of it mentions an official MCP server or endpoint for connecting external agents. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
